messages:
Leah Kim: Morning team — Springridge ready to pilot. 8 seats, 3-week window. They want onboarding, cost projection, and a simple way to surface model regressions.
Kira (Springridge): Hi! Confirmed 2 PM PT Tues for kickoff. We'll have a PM + 2 engineers.
Leah Kim: @Samir can you take CSM? Focus: activation by day 7, renewal signal if <30% seat activation.
Samir Patel: On it. I'll draft an activation plan and a low-usage escalation playbook.
onboard-bot: New pilot requested — assign docs: Leah Kim, infra: Diego Ortiz, legal: intake-team.
Diego Ortiz: I'll set up a `pilot_springridge` tag and an event pipeline. Need a minimal schema for events.
Leah Kim: Minimal schema: user_id, seat_id, model, tokens, latency_ms, outcome_label (optional), prompt_hash.
Diego Ortiz: Example event payload I'll ask them to send:
```
POST /v1/telemetry
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <KEY>
Body: {"customer":"springridge","user_id":"u_123","model":"redwood-optimized","tokens":256,"lat_ms":120}
```
Diego Ortiz: I'll also put a quick Grafana panel: active seats, daily tokens, p95 latency. Export CSV link included.
Samir Patel: Enablement plan: 30m kickoff (goals + success metrics), 45m hands-on workshop, 15m followup Q&A. I'll include a 1-pager on "what to do if output is off".
Kira (Springridge): Can you also show cost burn examples? We want to estimate mid-pilot run-rate vs monthly expected.
Leah Kim: Diego add cost_per_1k_tokens to the dashboard. Samir — we'll attach a renewal risk note to the pilot ticket if activation <30% at day 7.
Samir Patel: Escalation: Day 3 reachout, Day 7 power-user call, Day 14 renewal check. I'll run a quick adoption nudge template.
Samir Patel: Template snippet for nudge email:
"Hey <name>, quick check — how's the pilot going? Need any prompts or config help?"
Kira (Springridge): That cadence works for us. Also requesting anonymized logs for one failing prompt case.
Diego Ortiz: We'll provide sanitized logs. Will include a checklist for redaction.
Leah Kim: Action items: Diego — telemetry + dashboard by EOD Monday. Samir — enablement deck and nudge templates. I'll send calendar invites and the pilot success criteria doc.
Kira (Springridge): Thanks team — excited to get started.
Leah Kim: Saving this thread as the source of truth for Springridge pilot orchestration. :white_check_mark:
